name: 记账·月度汇总
description: 按月聚合支出并组装为 show_summary 摘要结构（终点输出可直接透传 show_summary 工具）：总额/笔数/均值 + Top 3 分类。inputs：month 月份 yyyy-MM（空串=当月，SQL 内 date('now') 兜底）。两个 database 节点串行聚合，code 节点组装 {title, items}。

nodes.name: 月度总额聚合
nodes.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, ROUND(TOTAL(amount), 2) AS total, ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS avg_amount FROM expense WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', spent_at) = COALESCE(NULLIF(?, ''), strftime('%Y-%m', 'now', 'localtime'))

nodes.name: 分类聚合
nodes.sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS cnt, ROUND(TOTAL(amount), 2) AS total FROM expense WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', spent_at) = COALESCE(NULLIF(?, ''), strftime('%Y-%m', 'now', 'localtime')) GROUP BY category ORDER BY total DESC

nodes.name: 组装摘要结构
